verdict.rationale: Brex's own marketing claims 'automated receipts' with an AI-powered expense assistant and says it can 'automate GL coding by entity globally,' and the Expenses API exposes receipt match and receipt uploads. Together these point to a first-party capture-and-coding flow, but all of it rests on one-line marketing and API summaries. missing for 10: documentation that receipts are captured automatically at the moment of the card transaction, detail on how automatic coding is applied to card expenses, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the flow needs no manual entry.
